patch_description: A fundamentally different, symmetry-aware ansatz that aggressively shares parameters to improve generalization while reducing overfitting. This design replaces a purely CZ-centric ring with a shared-parameter CRX ring on the outer perimeter, plus hub entanglement between the center and edge qubits using a single shared parameter for both CRZ and CRX gate types. Pre/post layers still use symmetry-sharing RZ/RY rotations. This combination aims to tighten parameter usage (fewer effective degrees of freedom per block) while enriching expressivity via simultaneous, parameter-shared multi-gate entanglement across the tic-tac-toe board. The result should improve validation accuracy, reduce train-test gaps, and maintain the same input/output semantics.
